blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Home Extension Cost in Torquay in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to home extension costs in Torquay, covering pricing factors, Surf Coast building requirements, and what to budget for your project.
body: Planning a home extension in Torquay is an exciting step toward creating the living space your family needs without the hassle of relocating. Whether you are adding a second storey to your beachside property or extending your ground-floor living area to capture views of the Surf Coast, understanding the cost of a home extension in Torquay is essential for effective budgeting. As a registered builder working across Torquay, Armstrong Creek, and the greater Geelong region, we help homeowners navigate the financial landscape of home extensions. In 2026, extension costs in the Torquay area are influenced by a range of factors including project scope, materials, site conditions, and compliance with Victorian building regulations.

The cost of a home extension in Torquay varies significantly depending on the size and complexity of the project. A simple single-room ground-floor extension might start from $2,000 to $3,000 per square metre, while a more complex double-storey extension with structural modifications can range from $3,500 to $5,000 per square metre or more. For a typical 40-square-metre single-storey extension in Torquay, homeowners can expect to invest between $80,000 and $120,000. Larger projects, such as a 60-square-metre double-storey extension with new bathroom and kitchen components, may range from $200,000 to $350,000. These figures reflect current 2026 pricing across the Surf Coast and Greater Geelong building market.

Several key factors influence the final cost of your Torquay home extension. The complexity of the design plays a major role, as extensions that require structural engineering, load-bearing wall removal, or integration with existing rooflines will incur higher costs. Site access is another consideration, particularly in established Torquay neighbourhoods where tight boundaries can make material delivery and crane access more challenging. The choice of materials also impacts pricing, with sustainably sourced timber, double-glazed windows, and energy-efficient insulation adding to upfront costs but delivering long-term savings. Additionally, extensions in coastal areas like Torquay must account for salt-air resistance and wind ratings specified in Australian Standard AS 1170.

Council approval and building permits are a mandatory part of any home extension in Torquay. The Surf Coast Shire requires development permits for most extensions, and costs for these permits typically range from $1,500 to $5,000 depending on the scope of the project. Your registered builder should manage the permit application process, including preparing architectural drawings and structural engineering documentation. In Torquay, the Surf Coast Shire has specific guidelines relating to setbacks, building height, and coastal vegetation protection that must be addressed during the planning phase. Working with an experienced Torquay builder ensures your extension design meets all local planning requirements from the outset.

The coastal environment in Torquay presents unique building considerations that can affect extension costs. Salt air, strong winds, and exposure to weather require durable materials and construction methods that may cost more upfront but protect your investment long-term. Marine-grade fixings, corrosion-resistant cladding, and quality waterproofing are essential for extensions in Surf Coast properties. Energy efficiency is another factor, with Victorian building regulations requiring minimum insulation and glazing standards. For Torquay homeowners, investing in energy-efficient extension design can reduce heating and cooling costs in the variable Surf Coast climate, making your extension both comfortable and cost-effective over time.

When budgeting for your Torquay home extension, it is wise to include a contingency of 10 to 15 per cent of the total project cost to account for unexpected site conditions or design adjustments. At Registered Builder Torquay, we provide detailed, fixed-price quotes that break down every component of your extension, from foundations and framing to electrical, plumbing, and finishing works. Our transparent pricing approach means there are no hidden costs or surprise charges once construction begins. We recommend getting at least two to three quotes from registered builders in the Torquay and Geelong area to compare pricing and ensure you are receiving fair, competitive rates for your extension project.

Choosing the right registered builder for your Torquay home extension is one of the most important decisions you will make. Look for a builder with demonstrated experience in Surf Coast construction, a portfolio of completed extensions in the Torquay area, and a commitment to clear communication throughout the build. At Registered Builder Torquay, we have delivered home extensions across Torquay, Armstrong Creek, Geelong, and the wider Surf Coast region, with every project completed to Australian building standards. If you are planning a home extension in Torquay in 2026, contact us for a free, no-obligation consultation and detailed fixed-price quote tailored to your specific needs.

blogPosts.title: Building a New Home on the Surf Coast: A Torquay Builder's Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Torquay and Surf Coast homebuyers need to know about building a new home, from site selection and design to construction costs and timelines.
body: Building a new home on the Surf Coast is one of the most rewarding investments a family can make, and Torquay continues to be one of Victoria's most sought-after locations for new residential construction. With its world-class beaches, growing community, and proximity to Geelong and Melbourne, Torquay offers an exceptional lifestyle that draws new residents every year. As a registered builder based in Armstrong Creek, we work with homeowners across Torquay and the Surf Coast to turn new-build dreams into reality. This guide covers everything you need to know about building a new home in Torquay, from understanding local costs and timelines to navigating Victorian building regulations.

The cost of building a new home in Torquay in 2026 depends on the size, design complexity, and level of finishes you choose. For a standard single-storey home of approximately 180 square metres, construction costs typically range from $350,000 to $500,000, not including land. A double-storey home of similar size may cost between $450,000 and $650,000. Premium custom builds with high-end finishes, architectural design features, and luxury inclusions can exceed $800,000. These estimates reflect current material and labour costs in the Geelong and Surf Coast region. When planning your new build in Torquay, it is important to budget for additional costs such as site preparation, soil testing, council fees, and utility connections.

Site selection and preparation are critical first steps when building in Torquay. The Surf Coast region features varied terrain, from flat coastal blocks near the beach to sloping sites with ocean views. Each site type presents different construction requirements and costs. Flat sites in newer Torquay estates typically require less site preparation, while elevated blocks may need cut-and-fill earthworks, retaining walls, and engineering solutions for sloping terrain. Soil conditions in the Torquay area can range from sandy coastal soils to reactive clay, and a geotechnical assessment will determine foundation requirements. As your Torquay registered builder, we manage all site investigation and preparation to ensure your new home is built on solid foundations.

Designing a new home for the Torquay lifestyle means considering how you live, entertain, and enjoy the coastal environment. Many Torquay homeowners prioritise open-plan living areas that flow seamlessly to outdoor spaces, capturing natural light and coastal breezes. Durable, low-maintenance materials are popular choices, reflecting the practical demands of beachside living. Energy efficiency is increasingly important in new Torquay builds, with homeowners opting for solar panels, reverse-brick veneer construction, and high-performance insulation to manage the Surf Coast's variable climate. At Registered Builder Torquay, we work with local architects and designers to create new homes that balance aesthetics, functionality, and compliance with the National Construction Code and Victorian building standards.

Building approvals and permits are an essential part of any new-build project in Torquay. The Surf Coast Shire manages planning permits for new residential construction, and applications must demonstrate compliance with local planning overlays, setback requirements, and design guidelines. In Torquay, additional considerations may include coastal hazard overlays, vegetation protection, and bushfire attack level assessments depending on your block's location. The permit process typically takes eight to twelve weeks, and your registered builder should prepare and lodge all necessary documentation, including architectural plans, engineering reports, and energy efficiency ratings. At Registered Builder Torquay, we have extensive experience navigating the Surf Coast Shire approval process.

Construction timelines for new homes in Torquay typically range from ten to fourteen months from slab pour to completion, depending on the complexity of the design. The build process generally progresses through slab preparation, framing, lock-up, fixing, and finishing stages. Weather conditions on the Surf Coast can influence construction schedules, particularly during the wetter winter months when pouring concrete and external works may be affected. Clear communication between you and your builder is essential throughout the process, ensuring decisions on fixtures, fittings, and finishes are made on time to avoid delays. Registered Builder Torquay provides regular progress updates and a clear construction timeline so you always know where your project stands.

Selecting the right registered builder is the most important decision you will make when building a new home in Torquay. Look for a builder with proven experience in Surf Coast construction, a strong portfolio of completed new builds in the Torquay and Geelong region, and transparent, fixed-price quoting. At Registered Builder Torquay, we pride ourselves on delivering quality new homes across Torquay, Armstrong Creek, and the wider Surf Coast with clear communication, honest pricing, and meticulous craftsmanship. If you are considering building a new home in Torquay, contact us for a free consultation and detailed quote tailored to your vision and budget.

blogPosts.title: Outdoor Living in Torquay: Building Decks, Pergolas and Alfresco Spaces on the Surf Coast
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover how to create the perfect outdoor living space in Torquay with expert advice on decks, pergolas, and alfresco builds suited to the Surf Coast climate.
body: Torquay is synonymous with outdoor living, and creating a beautiful, functional outdoor space is one of the best investments Surf Coast homeowners can make. From timber decks overlooking the ocean to sheltered pergolas designed for year-round entertaining, outdoor living construction in Torquay requires thoughtful planning and materials that can withstand the region's coastal conditions. As a registered builder specialising in outdoor living projects across Torquay and the Surf Coast, we design and construct outdoor spaces that complement your home, suit the local climate, and provide lasting enjoyment for your family. Whether you envision a simple timber deck or a fully equipped alfresco kitchen, this guide covers everything you need to know.

The cost of building a deck in Torquay varies depending on the materials, size, and design complexity. A standard timber deck using treated pine or hardwood typically costs between $250 and $400 per square metre, while composite decking products range from $350 to $550 per square metre. For a typical 25-square-metre deck in Torquay, you can expect to invest between $6,000 and $10,000 for timber, or $9,000 and $14,000 for composite materials. Premium hardwoods such as spotted gum or blackbutt, which are well-suited to Surf Coast conditions, will be at the higher end of the timber range. Elevated decks with balustrades, stairs, and integrated lighting will add to the overall cost but create a stunning outdoor feature.

Pergolas and covered outdoor areas are popular additions for Torquay homeowners who want to enjoy their outdoor space regardless of the weather. A basic timber pergola in Torquay typically costs between $3,000 and $6,000, while more elaborate structures with roofing, integrated lighting, and privacy screens range from $8,000 to $20,000. For Surf Coast properties, choosing materials that resist salt-air corrosion is essential. Powder-coated aluminium, marine-grade stainless steel fixings, and treated or naturally durable timber species such as cypress or hardwood will ensure your pergola stands up to Torquay's coastal environment. Retractable awnings and louvered roof systems offer flexibility, allowing you to control sun and rain exposure throughout the year.

Building in Torquay's coastal environment requires careful material selection and construction methods. Salt-laden air, strong UV exposure, and variable weather conditions mean that outdoor structures must be built to last. For decks, selecting timber with a natural durability rating suitable for in-ground or exposed applications is critical. Composite decking offers a low-maintenance alternative that resists fading, staining, and moisture damage, making it an excellent choice for Surf Coast homes. All outdoor construction in Torquay must comply with Victorian building regulations, including setbacks, height restrictions, and pool fencing requirements where applicable. As a registered builder, we ensure every outdoor living project meets the National Construction Code and Surf Coast Shire planning requirements.

The design of your outdoor living space should reflect how you use it and the unique character of your Torquay property. Many Surf Coast homeowners favour open-plan deck designs that connect indoor and outdoor living areas through large sliding or bi-fold doors. Integrated outdoor kitchens with built-in barbecues, preparation areas, and storage are increasingly popular, transforming decks and pergolas into true entertaining zones. Lighting is another key consideration, with LED strip lighting, recessed deck lights, and feature pendants creating ambience for evening gatherings. Landscaping around your outdoor structure, using native coastal plants such as coastal rosemary, lomandra, and banksia, can soften the built environment and enhance the Surf Coast aesthetic.

Planning approvals may be required for outdoor living projects in Torquay, depending on the size and location of the structure. Decks and pergolas that exceed certain height or setback thresholds will require a building permit from the Surf Coast Shire. Pool fencing, retaining walls, and structures near property boundaries also trigger specific regulatory requirements. As your registered builder in Torquay, we manage all permit applications and ensure your outdoor living project complies with local planning overlays and building regulations. Starting with a professional site assessment allows us to identify any planning considerations early, preventing costly delays and ensuring your project proceeds smoothly from design through to completion.

Investing in outdoor living construction adds significant value to your Torquay property while enhancing your daily lifestyle on the Surf Coast. Quality decks, pergolas, and alfresco spaces are among the most sought-after features for buyers in the Torquay and Geelong property market. At Registered Builder Torquay, we have completed outdoor living projects across Torquay, Jan Juc, Anglesea, and the wider Surf Coast, delivering durable, beautifully designed spaces that our clients enjoy for years. If you are ready to transform your backyard into an outdoor entertaining oasis, contact us for a free consultation and quote. Our team will help you design and build an outdoor living space perfectly suited to your Torquay home.

blogPosts.title: Renovating Your Torquay Home: A Complete Guide for Surf Coast Homeowners
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to home renovations in Torquay, covering costs, planning, building permits, and tips for a successful Surf Coast renovation project.
body: Home renovation is one of the most popular ways for Torquay homeowners to improve their living space, increase property value, and adapt their home to changing needs without the expense of relocating. Whether you are modernising a dated kitchen, adding a bathroom, or undertaking a full-scale interior makeover, a well-planned renovation can transform your Torquay home. The Surf Coast's unique coastal environment adds specific considerations to any renovation project, from material selection to compliance with local building regulations. As a registered builder with extensive experience across Torquay, Geelong, and the Surf Coast, we have put together this complete guide to help you plan, budget, and execute a successful home renovation.

Understanding renovation costs in Torquay is essential for effective budgeting. A cosmetic renovation, including repainting, new flooring, and minor fixture updates, typically costs between $10,000 and $30,000 for a standard three-bedroom home. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Torquay generally ranges from $25,000 to $50,000, while a bathroom renovation may cost between $15,000 and $35,000. Full-scale renovations involving structural changes, room reconfiguration, or multiple-room makeovers can range from $80,000 to $200,000 or more, depending on the scope. These figures reflect 2026 pricing across the Geelong and Surf Coast region. At Registered Builder Torquay, we provide detailed, fixed-price quotes that give you a clear picture of costs before any work begins.

The planning phase is critical to a successful Torquay renovation. Before any construction begins, define your goals, establish a realistic budget, and prioritise the areas of your home that will deliver the most value and enjoyment. Consider how the renovation will integrate with the existing structure, and whether any changes will require council approval. In Torquay, the Surf Coast Shire requires building permits for renovations that involve structural modifications, changes to the building envelope, or alterations to plumbing and drainage. Non-structural cosmetic changes typically do not require a permit, but it is always advisable to confirm requirements with your local council or your registered builder before commencing work.

The coastal location of Torquay introduces specific material and construction considerations for home renovations. Moisture, salt air, and temperature fluctuations can affect building materials over time, so selecting products designed for coastal exposure is important. In kitchens and bathrooms, waterproof membranes, corrosion-resistant fixings, and moisture-resistant plasterboard are essential for longevity. For external renovations, cladding, windows, and doors should meet wind and salt-spray ratings appropriate for the Surf Coast's exposure classification. Timber elements should be treated or naturally durable species suited to marine environments. At Registered Builder Torquay, we specify materials that are proven to perform in coastal Victorian conditions, ensuring your renovation withstands the test of time and the elements.

Managing the renovation process effectively requires clear communication between you and your builder. Establishing a detailed project timeline with key milestones helps keep the renovation on track and allows you to plan for any temporary disruptions to your household. In Torquay, where many homes are occupied during renovation, maintaining a clean and safe worksite is particularly important. At Registered Builder Torquay, we provide regular progress updates, a dedicated point of contact, and a clear schedule so you always know what to expect. Deciding on fixtures, fittings, and finishes early in the process helps avoid delays, as ordering lead times for tiles, tapware, and cabinetry can extend from two to eight weeks depending on availability.

Energy efficiency is an increasingly important consideration for Torquay renovations. Upgrading insulation, installing double-glazed windows, and improving draught sealing during your renovation can significantly reduce heating and cooling costs in the variable Surf Coast climate. Victorian building regulations specify minimum energy efficiency requirements for renovations, and exceeding these standards can improve comfort while reducing your environmental footprint. Renewable energy options such as solar panels and heat-pump hot water systems can also be integrated during the renovation process, taking advantage of the construction phase to minimise additional costs. For Torquay homeowners, an energy-efficient renovation delivers both immediate comfort improvements and long-term savings on household energy bills.

A well-executed renovation adds substantial value to your Torquay property. The Surf Coast real estate market places a premium on updated homes with modern kitchens, additional bathrooms, and improved living spaces. According to recent property data, quality renovations in Torquay can deliver a return on investment of 60 to 80 per cent or more, depending on the scope and quality of the work. Beyond financial returns, a renovation improves your daily living experience and ensures your home meets the needs of your family for years to come. At Registered Builder Torquay, we take pride in delivering renovations that enhance both the function and value of Surf Coast homes.

Choosing the right registered builder for your Torquay renovation is the most important step in ensuring a successful outcome. Look for a builder with experience in coastal construction, a portfolio of completed renovations in the Torquay and Geelong area, and a reputation for transparent communication and quality workmanship. At Registered Builder Torquay, we have completed renovation projects of all sizes across Torquay, Armstrong Creek, the Surf Coast, and Greater Geelong. Our team manages every aspect of your renovation from initial consultation through to the final walkthrough, ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience. Contact us today for a free, no-obligation consultation and let us help you bring your Torquay renovation vision to life.
